from icalendar import Calendar, Event
from datetime import datetime
import pytz

cal = Calendar()

cal.add('version', '2.0')

event.add('summary', 'Project Kickoff Meeting')
event.add('description', 'Project kickoff meeting to align on goals, scope, timeline, and team roles.')

event.add('dtend', tz.localize(datetime(2026, 8, 17, 12, 0)))
event.add('dtstamp', datetime.now(pytz.UTC))
event.add('uid', 'project-kickoff-20260817@calendar-assistant')
event.add('status', 'CONFIRMED')
event.add('transp', 'OPAQUE')
event.add('sequence', 0)

alarm = Alarm()
